items.title: 61521_David Albert Francis oral history interview
items.q: I did Bobby Darin's first big hit record, "Splish Splash"... I did "Splash Splash" with Bobby Darin, I did "Calendar Girl" with Bobby Darin

ctx.x: And we used to make quite a few demos for the [Hillary Range] Publishing Company that they used to send down there to Nashville and Memphis for Elvis Presley to learn.
And I remember Bobby Darin -- I did Bobby Darin's first big hit record, "Splish Splash". And after the record
